reviews.text: Shane is an absolute amazing veterinarian, had recently brought Matteo in for a neutering , I was nervous as past experience with my other cat and a different clinic didn’t go so well, however Shane took good care of Matteo, he responded to my call the next day when I had some follow up questions in a calm and reassuring manner which was comforting. Couldn’t recommend this practice enough, his kindness is absolutely heartwarming.
This veterinary is top class I wouldn't bring me digs anywhere els, Shane and his team are A1 😊👌
Shane is a very professional and highly experienced caring vet. They are very reasonably priced and very efficient and accommodating. I would highly recommend.
Great advice and care of the animals. Lovely staff
Really lovely practice. The vets and staff are great.

We have been attending Killester Vets with our dogs since they opened. Shane and the team are nothing less than incredible. They always treat us with the utmost respect, empathy and professionalism. We are always so incredibly grateful to Killester Vets for working so quickly to save our dog Peppa’s life in May 2025. She made a full recovery and has continued to live a very happy and healthy life thanks to Shane and the team.

Top Class vets!

Attentive and knowledgeable, you can tell there is a real care for the animals' wellbeing.

We had recently adopted a senior dog from a rescue shelter and he needed a once over when we got him home. I knew Shane from a previous location and was thrilled when he opened his own practice.  He has always, and continues to treat our pets like family. He's wonderful and the practice is lovely. The other staff are friendly and welcoming.  I won't be going anywhere else.
Shane has such genuine kindness and empathy. He showed us so much kindness and gave us time to say goodbye to our beloved Cody today.

Shane and his team are very professional. They are looking after our 2 white boxer girls.
Treating 1 of the girls for mast cell tumor cancer and Shane is on the ball. End of the phone if things take a turn. We are entirely grateful.

Our dog was very sick and Shane & his team were so amazing with her and ourselves too. Cant recommend enough. Our hearts were broken waiting to find out if she would be okay and when they gave her back she was happy and alert, so thankful again.
Absolute amazing experience with shane and the team, dog needed emergency surgery and they had her in straight away and saved her life,  couldn't recommend enough

First time visiting Killester vets yesterday with my cat.Very friendly staff and Shane"the vet" is a lovely guy and answered all my questions and explained everything to me. No rush.
Will be definitely be returning if needed.
Highly recommend.

We attended killester vets in March 2026  for a 2nd opinion on our little 5 year old  frenchie  and  I honestly  cannot thank Shane enough for the care he gave Monty over the past 3 months, right until his final day 😥🌈   We will forever be eternally grateful.   Youve such  a wonderful compassionate team  who genuinely care. …

I brought my cat, who is a regular here, to get groomed as he reacts very badly to brushing/grooming even by specialist cat groomers. He has arrived home like a brand new cat, all his matted fur and excess fur has been fully removed. I can already see his mood has improved and he is a very happy cat now 😺😸 super happy and would recommend to anyone who has a stubborn cat like mine!

Dr. Shane and his team are truly exceptional. I’m so grateful to have such a caring and professional clinic in the neighborhood. My cat Pumpkin has been with them since they first opened, and they’ve always provided outstanding care. Most recently, they were able to fit her in for an emergency appointment on short notice on a Saturday, followed by surgery on Monday. The compassion, responsiveness, and expertise they showed throughout were incredible. I highly recommend them.
Killester is the best vet after experiencing other vets
Shane, Niamh and Emma and the whole team are absolutely brilliant,  professional and friendly.

I would like to Thank the Vets in Killester vets for the care they gave to my little furry boy Snuggles Unfortunately Snuggles had to be put to sleep as he hadn't  been well and getting on a bit. Shane was very kind and compassionate. We got to give Snuggles his favourite Treats just before he passed and he loved it. Thank you very much to you all for his paw prints and his Hair and the lovely card.x
Great vets better then Amy lara
Fantastic vets. Shane is the first vet that our dog is completely comfortable with. Can't recommend highly enough.
We didn't have an appointment just dropped in . Saw the dog and sorted out the problem. 🥰 …

After our beautiful Mabel was horribly misdiagnosed twice, we were advised to contact Killester vets. They treated her so tenderly, with such care and concern. They listened to everything we were telling them, taking notes. They did imaging and biopsies.
Mabel was diagnosed with a tumor in her lung, her hip and lower leg, it was an aggressive cancer. She died in her sleep on Saturday evening. We are heartbroken to lose our girl but the end was peaceful.
We really can't recommend this practice enough, your pet is treated the way you treat them and you are listened to, not hurried along. The human touch is there. Thank you Shane and Emma for your care towards our Mabel, will be back with our other 2 doggies x
Top class vet. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

We couldn't be happier with Shane and his team at Killester Vets. They always find time for us and give us excellent care for our golden retriever Bobby. We have tried a few different vets in the area and find Killester Vets the best by a mile. We couldn't recommend enough.
Our cat Lola has never been able to stay calm with a Vet but Shane and the team are unique in their approach. Couldn’t recommend Killester vets more highly. Especially with nervous pets.

We are just endlessly grateful to have Shane, Emma, Niamh, Amy and the whole team right here in our neighbourhood. They have taken such wonderful care of our gorgeous Luna and Juno, and every visit reminds us how lucky we are to have them.

Shane in particular has a rare and special combination of intuition, calm understanding, and deep expertise that immediately puts you at ease. You never feel rushed, dismissed, or worried. Just completely listened to and reassured. It is so clear how much care and thought goes into every decision, and that level of attention makes all the difference when it comes to your dogs.

The entire team are kind, knowledgeable, and genuinely compassionate. Our dogs are always treated with such gentleness and respect, and as owners we feel completely supported and informed every step of the way. We cannot recommend them highly enough. Exceptional care, exceptional people, and such a comfort to know our dogs are in the very best hands. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I went to Killester vets for the first time yesterday with my cat I met Emma I have to say what a warm and caring person my cat took to her straight away the place has an amazing atmosphere I would highly recommend them thank you 🤗 …
Great staff .best vet on northside staff always ready to assist .shane always gives u sence off care.and willingness to listen...

The best vet in town! Emma took care of our lovely boy today :) after having some unpleasant blood taking experience with other vets, Emma was truly professional and caring. No sedatives, no stress and all handled in five minutes. Huge thanks to her and the team.

We brought our puppy Archie to see Shane and couldn’t be happier with the care. He was very attentive, took time to answer all of our questions in detail, and made Archie feel safe and comfortable. Many friends recommended him to us, and now we know exactly why. Highly recommend!
Very professional team and welcome !
Emma helped me when I found wildlife that needed wires removed from its legs. She treated the bird compassionately and with medicine. It was so kind of Killester Vets to help wildlife free of charge.

Shane is quite simply the best vet we have ever had. If he took humans I’d go there myself. We brought our dog down there in a very distressed state. He was very much touch and go. The level of compassion and professionalism shown by Shane and the team was outstanding. They genuinely care. We can’t thank them enough. Our dog is on the mend all thanks to them.

From the very beginning, Shane treated my pets with the same empathy, attention, and respect you'd offer a person. Every question was answered with patience, every concern taken seriously, and the level of care went far beyond anything I’d experienced before.

My cats were comfortable and treated with real gentleness. This was the first clinic that managed to take blood from my nervous cat without sedation and stress-free - Something others wouldn’t even attempt!

After so many years of  rushed through impersonal branch clinics, feeling dismissed by arrogant professionals and stressful situations, I'm glad I found Killester Vets.

Thank you, Shane, Emma, and the entire team, for looking after my 2 cats the way you did. Your dedication make all the difference.
Best in the business
Fluffy was well cared for.
Thanks for taking the time to leave a review Natalie 😊 …
Shane and his team do such a great job. So understanding, knowledgeable and gentle with my nervous little dog. Delighted to have him down the road.

Thank you, Shane, for meeting you once. The best VET in Dublin, maybe in the whole of Ireland. The first is a good person who doesn't work for just money. Thank you for taking care of my dog and cat. We appreciate you very much 🫂 …
Thanks Mags 😊 …

Last month our dog Max was gravely ill with pancreatitis. He's 15, so we didn't know if he'd make it or not. Throughout diagnosis and treatment we knew he was in the best hands with Shane. We trust his opinion implicitly. He is kind and compassionate and treats the animals as if they're his own. We wouldn't dream of going anywhere else. Thanks to Shane and his team we got our boy back and he's doing great.

We’ve been bringing our dog to Shane for some time now, and we couldn’t be more grateful for the care he provides. He’s incredibly knowledgeable, always taking the time to explain things clearly and thoroughly. What really stands out is how kind and attentive he is—not just to us, but to our dog, who likes him. It’s clear he genuinely cares, and that peace of mind means everything. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a vet who combines expertise with true compassion.
Both Shane and Emma are great. Took alot of time and did onky whatever our very nervous Greyhound was comfortable with. Would 100% recommend.

I can't recommend Shane, Niamh & the team at Killester Vets highly enough. Shane is an excellent vet and sincerely cares about the health and wellbeing of animals. He and his team have gone above and beyond for my pugs on many occasions and I can't thank them enough. If you're looking for a vet you should 100% visit Killester Vets.

My two favourite Vets in the world. Amazing empathy, compassion with my pets and also fantastic vets. Was delighted when Emma came on board too. All the staff are brilliant. Highly recommend Killester Vets. 💯💯💯 …
Excellent service
Genuine care for four legged family members 🐕 …
Brilliant vets highly recommend staff where absolutely fantastic with my frenchie

We are extremely pleased with our visit to Killester Vets. Dr. Shane took excellent care of our cat Peynir performing a dental surgery that went smoothly.
Peynir is now in great condition and fully recovered. Dr. Shane is a true professional who cares more about the well-being of animals than just the money. Highly recommended for anyone looking for compassionate and expert veterinary care!
Also whole team is amazing and super friendly!

Thank you!!

My dog became very ill quite suddenly recently. I brought him to Shane in Killester Vets and he performed emergency surgery.

Now, my dog is so much better, at 12 years old he's almost like he's 5 again. I'm really grateful for the care and attention Shane gave to my doggie. He is very professional and lovely to deal with.

Highly recommend this Vet. Thank you for everything 🙏

I'd been looking for a new vet for my 2 dogs, Killester vet came recommended. OMG I'm so happy I changed vets. Shane was amazing, gave my 2 dogs full examination, went through all options with me as one needs an operation. …
Shane and his team are knowledgeable, compassionate, and have always gone the extra mile in treating our dog Yuka. Many thanks to you all!
